facts.value: The 3T-MOTORS Matter Bridge is a Matter-compatible device for integrating 3T-MOTORS shutter and awning motors into Matter-based smart home systems. The bridge connects non-Matter-enabled motors to the Matter ecosystem and enables their control via compatible platforms such as Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and SmartThings. It supports basic functions such as open, close, stop, and positioning of shutter and awning drives. The objective is the integration of these devices into a manufacturer-independent smart home system in accordance with the Matter specification.

facts.value: Anona Holo is a smart lock that does not replace existing deadbolt. It has a beautiful appearance and works with Alexa, Google Home and Homekit by Matter protocol. Anona Holo supports diverse ways of lock and unlock, such as remote access by WiFi, near-field access by bluetooth, code lock/unlock with a keypad. It also provides mechanical thumb latch. One more thing is that it can automatically lock when detecting door closed. Anona Holo provides more safety for our customers with anomaly detection. When door has been opened for more than 10 minutes, it will send message to notify the owner. And if someone wants to crack the password violently, the keypad will fail functions in a certain period.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: In the event of a fire, every second counts , so a smoke detector must warn quickly and reliably. The PREFIRA SMART (SX3050M) excels in both. It offers advanced technology for improved smoke detection and comfort and integrates into smart homes via Matter over Thread. Thanks to its connectivity, you're alerted not only by the acoustic alarm at home, but also via push notification on your smartphone , enabling you to respond quickly, even when you're at work, shopping, or at the gym. We know smoke detectors can sometimes be intrusive, which is why the PREFIRA SMART (SX3050M) is optimized to reduce false alarms. It features automatic recalibration of the smoke chamber to reliably distinguish smoke from other particles like dust. Dual LEDs boost accuracy, and an insect screen prevents bugs from triggering alerts. The status LED is subtly embedded under the surface and has adaptive brightness , dimming automatically in dark rooms, making it ideal for bedrooms. Installation is simple: stick the base with integrated adhesive pad to the ceiling and magnetically attach the detector. With PREFIRA SMART (SX3050M), you protect yourself, your loved ones, and your home , smartly and comfortably.

facts.value: No matter where you are, control your home electronics using your tablet or smartphone with the Hombli Smart Swiss Socket Matter. Easily turn devices on/off, check their status, create schedules, and set timers using the Hombli app. Now upgraded with Matter support, this smart socket can be added to any major smart home platform, including Apple HomeKit, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and of course the Hombli app. Control your devices your way,whether through voice assistants, automation, or the intuitive Hombli app. With remote access, you can check the real-time status of your appliances anytime, anywhere. The smart socket also monitors energy usage for each connected device and shows you how much electricity it consumes. Please note: some advanced features, like energy monitoring, are not supported by all platforms,we recommend the Hombli app for the full experience.

Featuring a modern touchscreen interface, the Boldr thermostat blends seamlessly into any home while offering precise temperature, humidity, and fan control. Through the Boldr app or voice assistants, users can easily adjust settings, create schedules, and monitor energy use from anywhere. Built to deliver comfort and efficiency, the Boldr Smart Controller adapts to your lifestyle with geofencing, adaptive scheduling, and detailed usage insights , all while making legacy HVAC units part of a connected home experience.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: One Room. One Smart Panel. Infinite Possibilities. Smart homes are often built one device at a time. Gerlsair Aura X5 takes a different approach by bringing everything that matters in a room together into one intelligent wall-mounted smart panel. Featuring a 3.95-inch full-touch display, Aura X5 provides an intuitive interface for room comfort and automation. It directly integrates with central air conditioning, ducted HVAC systems, underfloor heating and fresh air ventilation, delivering responsive and reliable climate management from a single panel. Built on Gerlsair's extensive HVAC expertise, Aura X5 is compatible with major air conditioning brands and supports intelligent configuration for quick deployment. Advanced climate control capabilities make it suitable for both residential and professional smart building applications. Beyond climate management, Aura X5 monitors temperature, humidity, CO₂, TVOC and air quality to help create healthier indoor environments. It also enables seamless control of lighting, curtains and other Matter devices while working with occupancy sensors to deliver intelligent room automation that improves both comfort and energy efficiency. Rather than managing individual devices, Aura X5 unifies climate, environmental awareness and smart home interaction into one elegant Matter-enabled Smart Room Panel, providing a seamless experience whether controlled locally from the touchscreen or through Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Samsung SmartThings and other Matter-compatible ecosystems.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: TheJINK matter Hub is a multi-protocol control hub designed to serve as the central bridge for smart home or commercial automation environments.It enables seamless device coordination by supporting multiple communication methods and flexible peripheral access. Key Features: Multi-Protocol Support: Equipped with RF(Radio Frequency)and IR(Infrared)transmission capabilities,the gateway can control a wide range of legacy and modern appliances, including air conditioners, TVs,fans,and more. Built-in PIR Sensor: Integrated Passive Infrared (PIR)motion detection allows the gateway to respond to human presence,enabling intelligent automation scenarios such as lights-on when someone enters a room or adjusting the environment based on occupancy. Expandable Device Access: The gateway provides interfaces to connect with a wide variety of sub-devices(via Zigbee,Bluetooth,or other supported protocols),allowing for scalable deployment in different application spaces. Scene Automation &Interconnectivity: Through protocol bridging and scenario programming,the device enables linkage between traditional IR/RF-controlled devices and modern smart systems, acting as the central logic controller in the ecosystem. Applications: Ideal for smart homes,offices,hotels,or any environment that requires integration of traditional appliances into modern intelligent systems.Particularly useful in retrofitting existing devices without replacing them. Compliance: Designed to meet international standards for wireless communication,electromagnetic safety,and interoperability.

facts.value: Motionblinds Matter Wi-Fi Bridge , Control your Motionblinds motors from anywhere in the world with the Motionblinds Matter Wi-Fi Bridge smartphone application. , Automate your Motionblinds with scenes and timers, after which they automatically move to preset positions. , Let the blinds work with other smart devices via smart home platforms such as Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Samsung SmartThings, and many others. Installation Already have motorized blinds that are powered by Motionblinds? Then you can easily expand with a Motionblinds Matter Wi-Fi Bridge to remotely control your blinds and connect to smart home platforms. Download the Motionblinds Matter app and follow the steps in the app to connect the bridge to your Wi-Fi network. Pair your blinds with the bridge, and you are ready to control and automate the blinds with your smartphone. Operation In the Motionblinds Matter app, you can control your blinds to any position you want, wherever you are in the world. The app shows the positions of your blinds to the nearest percent. You can automatically move your blinds to preset positions by programming scenes and timers in the app. Already have smart devices like smart lighting, a smart thermostat, or a smart doorbell? Through smart home platforms like Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and Samsung SmartThings you can let your blinds work together with these devices for optimal convenience, safety, and energy efficiency in your home. Make your home smarter with the Motionblinds Matter Wi-Fi Bridge!

These changes do not affect Matter functionality, network behavior, security mechanisms, protocol implementation, interoperability, or user interaction through Matter. No new Matter features, clusters, endpoints, or radio functions have been added.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Smart speakers are likely to be the quintessential Smart Home controllers. However, as Smart Homes become more widespread in the near future, homes will be filled with numerous smart devices, each with unique names, potentially leading to confusion when trying to control them all. Our product, the Matter Controller, provides a user interface for comfortably operating these devices through hand gestures and direct touch panel controls. The Hand Gesture UI consists of natural movements that don't require memorization and are composed of simple expressions. This controller is also accessible to individuals with speech impairments, such as those who are hearing impaired. We have implemented these software components into a mirror, a common household item. This integration allows the Matter Controller to blend seamlessly into the living environment, enabling users to comfortably control their devices with hand gestures and touch panel interactions.

This is not only convenient, but also ideal for safety when you are not at home. Set timers to automatically switch your lights on and off at desired times. Create a cozy atmosphere without any hassle, wherever and whenever you want. With the integrated energy meter function of the Calex smart plug, you can gain direct insight into the power consumption and costs of your connected devices. With the Calex smart plug, you put an end to unnecessary power consumption. Standby devices are a thing of the past, because you can easily switch them off remotely. This smart function makes the plug not only handy, but also a valuable tool for anyone working on saving energy at home. Key benefits •Monitor your energy consumption in real time •Save energy and minimize standby consumption •Set timers and schedules •Turn ordinary devices into smart devices

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Based on the CHIP SDK, Eltako has developed its own flexible device platform. Essentially, all Eltako devices are Matter Bridges / Aggregators. Specific Interfaces / Endpoints can be de-activated and re-activated in the field by endusers. The Eltako platform will support a piggy-back adapter to bridge various Enocean devices. All Eltako devices share exactly the same firmware. Device variants are controlled with an Eltako's internal configuration, and not by code variants, i.e. to minimize the QM test efforts internally. So far, the platform with all device variants has been conformance tested at TÜV already. Currently, another ATL test is planned with the Enocean piggy-back adapter installed, subject to futher CSA certification applications in the future.

Acts as a gateway and guarantees that you can operate the KNX components in a house and query their status using Apple, Amazon, Google and Matter devices. This component makes it possible to operate the lighting, blind or room temperature controller using simple voice control. Up to 150 functions can be used. Busch-VoiceControl® is an official certified HomeKit and Matter accessory. Complete web-based commissioning. Compatible with ABB i-bus® KNX External power supply: 10-36 VDC (SELV).

facts.value: BUSY Bar is a customizable IoT productivity and attention-management device featuring an RGB LED matrix on the front, a rear grayscale OLED display, and physical controls. It integrates with mobile and desktop applications, supports third-party services, and provides an extensible API. BUSY Bar functions as an advanced Pomodoro timer, allowing users to clearly communicate their busy status through images and video displayed on the LED screen, set focus countdowns, and automatically block notifications on phones and PCs. When paired with companion apps and smart home systems, BUSY Bar can automatically change its status during calls or meetings, integrate with smart home ecosystems via Matter, and trigger automation scenarios to create an optimal environment for focused work. In terms of connectivity, the device supports Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, and provides USB Virtual LAN for direct, local network access without relying on external connectivity. The device provides official libraries for Python, JavaScript, and Go, supports MQTT for event-based integrations, and exposes an open HTTP API, enabling deep customization and the development of custom applications. BUSY Bar can also operate autonomously thanks to its built-in battery.

facts.value: Leading RF computing performance To fulfill the requirements of real-time processing and efficient communication, the GD32VW553 series MCU incorporates a new open-source instruction set architecture with the RISC-V processor core, boasting a maximum clock frequency of 160 MHz. Additionally, it incorporates advanced DSP hardware acceleration, a double-precision floating-point unit (FPU), instruction expansion interfaces, and various other resources. Through excellent microarchitecture design, this combination results in outstanding energy efficiency, while providing flexibility for scalability. The integrated 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi 6 RF module follows the IEEE 802.11ax standard and is backward compatible with the IEEE 802.11b/g/n standard, ensuring its suitability for different network environments. It supports Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access (OFDMA) enabling multiple devices to share channel resources, resulting in 60% higher data transmission rate compared to Wi-Fi 4. Additionally, it offers support for Multi-User Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MU-MIMO), enabling multiple devices to work simultaneously without interfering with each other, thus achieving high-efficiency and low-latency communication in multi-device high-density access scenarios. The integrated Bluetooth LE 5.2 RF module extends the communication distance, increases throughput, enhances security, and saves power following the latest Bluetooth specifications. It provides 2 Mbps high-speed data mode and multiple rates of 125K/500Kbps to effectively reduce transmission time and improve sensitivity. It facilitates the establishment and configuration of stable and high-speed wireless networks even in the case of multiple devices and complex environments. The new Combo Wireless MCU offers advanced baseband and RF performance with a variety of additional features. It supports the wireless coexistence protocol based on the Package Traffic Arbitration (PTA) mechanism, significantly reducing same-frequency interference caused by Wi-Fi and Bluetooth; thereby enhancing the stability of signal reception. Additionally, it is equipped with Automatic Gain Control (AGC) in a high dynamic range to effectively enhance signal quality. Thanks to the Target Wake Time (TWT) of Wi-Fi 6, GD32VW553 can flexibly schedule the sleep and wake-up time, improving energy-saving efficiency and meeting the access requirements of wireless devices with low power consumption and long battery life. High integration and security The new GD32VW553 series integrates up to 4MB Flash, 320KB SRAM, and 32KB configurable Instruction Cache (I-Cache) to greatly improve CPU processing efficiency. The GD32VW553, delivering excellent wireless performance, is also equipped with rich universal wired interfaces, including three U(S)ART, two I2C, one SPI, one four-wire QSPI, and up to 29 programmable GPIO pins. Its built-in components include two 32-bit general-purpose timers, two 16-bit general-purpose timers, four 16-bit basic timers, one PWM advanced timer, and one 12-bit ADC. The power supply voltage ranges from 1.8 V to 3.6 V and it offers high temperature up to 105℃ to meet the application scenarios such as industrial control interconnection, lighting equipment, and socket panels. The GD32VW553 series also provides multiple security features to streamline secure connection and management of high-performance wireless devices. It supports the Wi-Fi Protected Access (WPA) security feature, incorporating new WPA3 encryption technologies for both personal and corporate networks. The hardware encryption and decryption engine support DES, triple DES, AES, and Hash algorithms. It also supports Public Key Cryptographic Acceleration Unit (PKCAU) to ensure confidentiality and data integrity during wireless communication. The True Random Number Generator (TRNG) can provide unpredictable data for key generation across a variety of security protocols, further enhancing the system's security capabilities.

It provides 2 Mbps high-speed data mode and multiple rates of 125K/500Kbps to effectively reduce transmission time and improve sensitivity. It facilitates the establishment and configuration of stable and high-speed wireless networks even in the case of multiple devices and complex environments. The new Combo Wireless MCU offers advanced baseband and RF performance with a variety of additional features. It supports the wireless coexistence protocol based on the Package Traffic Arbitration (PTA) mechanism, significantly reducing same-frequency interference caused by Wi-Fi and Bluetooth; thereby enhancing the stability of signal reception. Additionally, it is equipped with Automatic Gain Control (AGC) in a high dynamic range to effectively enhance signal quality. Thanks to the Target Wake Time (TWT) of Wi-Fi 6, GD32VW553 can flexibly schedule the sleep and wake-up time, improving energy-saving efficiency and meeting the access requirements of wireless devices with low power consumption and long battery life. High integration and security The new GD32VW553 series integrates up to 4MB Flash, 320KB SRAM, and 32KB configurable Instruction Cache (I-Cache) to greatly improve CPU processing efficiency. The GD32VW553, delivering excellent wireless performance, is also equipped with rich universal wired interfaces, including three U(S)ART, two I2C, one SPI, one four-wire QSPI, and up to 29 programmable GPIO pins. Its built-in components include two 32-bit general-purpose timers, two 16-bit general-purpose timers, four 16-bit basic timers, one PWM advanced timer, and one 12-bit ADC. The power supply voltage ranges from 1.8 V to 3.6 V and it offers high temperature up to 105℃ to meet the application scenarios such as industrial control interconnection, lighting equipment, and socket panels. The GD32VW553 series also provides multiple security features to streamline secure connection and management of high-performance wireless devices. It supports the Wi-Fi Protected Access (WPA) security feature, incorporating new WPA3 encryption technologies for both personal and corporate networks. The hardware encryption and decryption engine support DES, triple DES, AES, and Hash algorithms. It also supports Public Key Cryptographic Acceleration Unit (PKCAU) to ensure confidentiality and data integrity during wireless communication. The True Random Number Generator (TRNG) can provide unpredictable data for key generation across a variety of security protocols, further enhancing the system's security capabilities.

facts.value: The Contact Sensor is an intelligent home device that uses wireless connection and sensor technology to detect the open/close status of doors and windows. It usually consists of two parts: a magnet and a sensor installed on the door/window frame. When the door/window is closed, the magnet will approach the sensor, creating a closed circuit, allowing the Contact Sensor to determine whether the door/window is closed. If the door/window is opened, the circuit between the magnet and sensor will be disconnected, and the Contact Sensor will detect the status change and send notification to the user. The Contact Sensor can be paired with a smart home system or a smartphone application, allowing users to monitor the status of doors and windows in real-time, as well as ensuring home security at all times.

It uses technologies such as infrared or ultrasonic waves to detect changes in motion, heat and sound in the surrounding environment and identify whether there are people inside the room based on these changes. Once someone enters the room, the Occupancy Sensor will automatically turn on lighting, adjust temperature and humidity levels, etc., to improve the user's comfort and convenience. When there is no one in the room, the sensor will automatically turn off lighting and other electrical appliances, saving energy and reducing maintenance costs. Occupancy Sensor can be paired with smart home systems to enable a smarter and more convenient lifestyle.

facts.value: Compact and exquisite, shimmering with radiant beauty The Nova Desk Lamp Pro 9080 is a smart ambient light designed specifically for desktop spaces, seamlessly combining RGBIC color technology with a compact aesthetic. Standing approximately 396mm tall and just 80mm in diameter, its design features a creamy white base, gradient black accents, and a semi-transparent shade that effortlessly blends into gaming rooms, study desks, nightstands, or coffee tables. Pure color, seamless gradient Featuring a three-section RGBIC LED design,top (5050), middle (2020), and bottom (2020),with 48 individually controllable LEDs. Although white light CCT is not supported, rich white tones can be achieved through RGB blending, enabling smooth, stepless adjustment across 160,000 colors. Supports dynamic effects such as flowing light, breathing, and pulsing, with natural and fluid color transitions. Smart control, rhythm at your fingertips Supports physical buttons, smartphone app, and dual-mode WiFi (2.4GHz) + Bluetooth control. Equipped with a high-sensitivity microphone offering a wide pickup range (100Hz,100kHz), it precisely syncs to music beats, creating an immersive desktop audio-visual experience. Control range exceeds 10 meters with fast response. Precision craftsmanship, stable and reliable. The lamp body is primarily made of PC material, lightweight and durable (approximately 507g). With an IP20 protection rating, it is suitable for indoor use. Includes a 5V/3A power adapter (ETL/1310 certified), with standby power consumption under 1W. Comes with a 2-year warranty and a switch life of 15,000 cycles. Whether it's intense gaming, late-night work, or a romantic drink, the Nova Desk Lamp Pro 9080 brings emotion and energy to your desk with its light and shadow.

facts.value: Light and shadow follow the sound, and sound moves the heart. The Nova Sound Lamp Pro is a desktop ambient device that combines high-fidelity audio with intelligent, colorful lighting. More than just a lamp, it's a Bluetooth speaker capable of playing music and white noise, creating an immersive experience of "sound you can see." Professional sound quality with immersive audio experience. Equipped with custom full-range speakers (tuned in collaboration with JBL for select models), delivering rich bass and clear mid-to-high frequencies. Supports Bluetooth 5.0 wireless playback, as well as wired connection via AUX. Features built-in white noise modes (rain, ocean waves, campfire, etc.), enabling one-touch sleep and relaxation. Flagship lighting effects, individually controlled for stunning brilliance Featuring RGBICWW technology (RGB + independent control of cool and warm white), each LED can independently display different colors across multiple zones. Supports 16 million colors and dynamic effects such as flowing light, marquee, and gradient transitions,eliminating monochrome or uniform color changes to deliver a more dazzling visual experience with rich depth. Millisecond-level audio-visual synchronization Equipped with a dedicated audio sampling chip, it delivers millisecond-precise rhythm. When music starts, lights dance in sync; when the beat drops, colors instantly shift. Compared to standard microphones, it offers higher accuracy and lower latency, providing a truly integrated audio-visual experience. Wireless and portable with worry-free battery life Equipped with a large 5200mAh battery, it provides up to 6,8 hours of continuous lighting and music playback on a full charge. Its lightweight design (approximately 650g) allows effortless movement,ideal for balconies, bathrooms, camping, and more. facts.label: Description
facts.value: In-lite produces numerous SMART products such as garden lamps and transformers that include a 2.4GHz radio module that uses a proprietary modulation scheme to form a Mesh network to communicate between these devices. The SMART BRIDGE can be used to couple this proprietary mesh network to a LAN network and/or cloud service. It keeps track of all devices on the mesh network, their state, whether they are currently powered up and reachable or not, what needs to be done to turn a certain mesh device on, etc. The SMART BRIDGE allows Matter controllers to control all of a user's SMART products by providing a Matter bridge to the LAN network.

facts.label: Certified name
facts.value: Infineon Wi-Fi Door Lock with OPTIGA Trust M MTR

facts.label: Description
facts.value: This Infineon Wi-Fi Door Lock hardware development platform is a feature rich tool for creating secure and convenient access systems. It combines the strengths of the PSoC 62S2 Wi-Fi BT Pioneer Kit (CY8CKIT-062S2-43012) with the OPTIGA Trust M MTR security solution to make the ideal smart door lock combination. The PSoC 62S2 Wi-Fi BT Pioneer Kit (CY8CKIT-062S2-43012) helps developers and engineers achieve reliable, ultra-low power Matter over Wi-Fi solutions and helps them get to market faster. This feature rich hardware evaluation platform enables development of applications based on the PSoC 62 series MCU and AIROC CYW43012 Wi-Fi + Bluetooth combo device. PSoC 62 series MCUs are built on an ultra-low power 40-nm platform, based on a dual CPU architecture of Arm Cortex-M4 and Arm Cortex-M0+, with low-power Flash technology, embedded security, programmable digital and analog resources, and best-in-class CAPSENSE technology for touch and proximity applications. Infineon's AIROC CYW43012 is an ultra-low power single-chip, combo device that supports 1×1 dual-band 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi 4 (802.11n) and Bluetooth 5.4. OPTIGA Trust M MTR is Infineon's OPTIGA Trust M, a CC EAL6+ (high) certified discrete security solution combined with a Matter provisioning service. It is Matter-certified and works with any MCU/SoC, making it easy to add secured Matter compatibility to existing IoT designs. OPTIGA™ Trust M MTR provides a secure I2C channel to communicate to add an additional layer of security. Working closely with Infineon's partner Kudelski IoT, the solution offers late stage personalized Device Attestation Certificate (DAC) injection to give OEMs the flexibility to update DACs up to the start of production. This combination makes it an ideal solution for building secure access systems, like smart door locks.

facts.value: The Lennox Smart Thermostat family brings together advanced environmental control, intelligent automation, and seamless system integration to deliver a unified, high‑performance home comfort experience. These thermostats are engineered to work with premium Lennox® communicating equipment and Lennox Smart Accessories, enabling precise management of temperature, humidity, and indoor air quality across all models. Built on a foundation of adaptive intelligence, the family incorporates features such as Smart Away™, which uses smartphone geo‑fencing to enhance energy efficiency by adjusting settings automatically when occupants leave or return, and Feels Like™ temperature management, which accounts for humidity to deliver a truer sense of comfort. All models offer versatile programming, One‑Touch Away Mode, and robust system diagnostics designed to keep equipment running at peak performance. Remote access through the Lennox app allows homeowners to monitor and control their environment from anywhere, and compatibility with leading smart home platforms,such as Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant,ensures effortless integration into modern connected homes.

facts.value: The Lockin smart lock is a connected door lock designed for residential access control and smart home integration. The product supports Matter and is intended to operate within Matter-enabled ecosystems, enabling interoperability with compatible smart home platforms. Users can operate and manage the lock locally or remotely through the Lockin Smart mobile application or via compatible Matter-enabled smart home interfaces. The product supports keyless access methods, including onboard user authentication features, allowing authorized users to unlock the door without a physical key. Access permissions can be configured through the Lockin Smart app, enabling users to add or remove authorized individuals. Door status and basic event information can be made available to the user, and notifications or automations may be configured through integrated smart home services. The product is powered by an internal rechargeable lithium-ion battery designed for residential use. Charging is performed through a supported charging interface. The Lockin Smart Deadbolt is designed to fit standard U.S. deadbolt door preparations and can be installed using common household tools. Commissioning and onboarding into a Matter network are guided through the Lockin Smart application. Overall, the product provides a secure, flexible, and interoperable smart locking solution for modern residential environments.

The lock is powered by a lithium battery, offering reliable performance without frequent charging. Additionally, the built-in door status sensor provides instant alerts whenever the door's status changes, ensuring peace of mind about the security of your home.

facts.value: This roller motor series is not only versatile but also utilizes the Thread connectivity technology, ensuring seamless integration with smart home systems. It is suitable for a wide range of blinds and covers, including roller blinds, Roman blinds, Venetian blinds, vertical blinds, pleated blinds, panel curtains, sheer curtains, blackout curtains, and more. With its low power consumption, it can be conveniently powered by either a battery or an AC adapter, providing flexibility in installation options. The motor's compact design allows for easy installation and discreet operation. It offers precise control over the movement of window coverings, allowing users to adjust the amount of light and privacy in their space effortlessly. The motor operates quietly, ensuring a peaceful and comfortable environment. With its compatibility with projection screens and photography backdrops, this motor is a versatile solution for both residential and commercial settings. Whether it's creating a cozy ambiance in a living room, achieving optimal lighting conditions in a home theater, or enhancing the aesthetics of a photography studio, this motor provides reliable and efficient motorized operation. In addition to its functional benefits, this roller motor series also boasts a sleek and modern design, complementing various interior styles. Its compatibility with smart home systems allows for convenient control through voice commands or mobile apps, adding an extra layer of convenience to your daily life. Overall, this roller motor series with Thread connectivity technology offers a comprehensive solution for window coverings, providing convenience, efficiency, and versatility for a wide range of applications.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: The mediola Matter Bridge is a flexible platform targeted at product manufacturers in the home and building technology space, enabling them to integrate existing wireless and wireline products based on proprietary protocols or pre-Matter standards with the rapidly growing Matter ecosystem. The bridge is based on the proven mediola smart home gateway technology that supports over 130 brands with more than 3.000 device types, used in over 250.000 households in Europe today. Thanks to its unique architecture, Mediola can rapidly create new types of the bridge product, supporting protocols and device types as precisely selected by OEM partners. The Matter protocol is entirely handled by the Bridge's main processor, that handles Wi-Fi and LAN as well. The mediola Matter Bridge uses essentially the same gateway processor technology as the various mediola Smart Home gateways. In its architecture, protocols, RF + controller settings, message types and formats, data types, actual data points, the protocol's state engines (if there are any), plus gateway behavior are defined in JSON. Such definitions are pre-compiled into a binary format and then executed in the gateway processor engine with a generic parser, formatter, and state-engine handler. Mediola can rapidly add support for new or changed Matter device types, clusters, or other data model elements by changing the software on the Bridge's main processor only. New bridged devices or even new protocols are typically supported by configuration changes only, i.e. invisible for the Matter code running on the main processor. The result is a highly flexible architecture that separates changes of Matter from changes of device types device type and protocols. OEM customers benefit from a well-proven architecture, clear and simple project structures, and optimal technology re-use, resulting in high quality bridge at attractive costs. Especially important is the effective cost reduction over the entire lifetime of members of the product family. Changes in the Matter protocol, the matter SDK, or the level of support of Matter are implemented once, retested for Matter conformance, and used across the entire product platform. Additions or changes to the spectrum of supported bridged devices are changes in the configuration that do not affect the software on the main processor. This base product of the mediola Matter Bridge supports two radios at 868 and 433 MHz plus a CAN interface for the addition of adapters to various wired interfaces in the building technology industry. The hardware is designed to be flexibly delivered in hardware variants that are subsets of the base products in order to meet aggressive cost targets. The mediola Matter Control app ("MMC App") is used for local control of the bridges. It enables the inclusion and exclusion of bridged devices to the Matter bridge. Furthermore, it allow to locally configure and control bridged devices. Through the MMC App mediola can support features of OEM products that are not yet available in Matter. In summary, the mediola Matter bridge together with the MMC App allows product manufacturers in the home and building technology space to capture the chances from Matter without reducing their ability to use and rapidly create new features independently of Matter.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: The mediola Smart Home 2.0 module is a cutting-edge OEM product designed to equip motorized window covering systems with support of Matter over Thread, Bluetooth and Sub-1 GHz wireless communication. Based on an innovative and modular hardware architecture, the SH 2.0 module offers easy integration into a wide range of product designs. A key innovation is mediola's newly developed Multi-Stack technology, which enables simultaneous support for multiple communication protocols. The universal SH 2.0 Core Module operates autonomously and includes all control logic, including full Matter compatibility. To ensure easy adaptation to different mainboard configurations, mediola additionally provides special Adapter Boards as a flexible hardware bridge. These can be customized and equipped with 433 / 868 MHz transceivers, enabling reliable Sub-1 GHz communication. Thanks to the integrated Multi-Stack technology and mediola connect protocol, multiple applications and communication layers can run simultaneously. This allows products to be controlled via Thread, Bluetooth, and Sub-1 GHz wireless communication at the same time. Thus, devices can be operated via Bluetooth without network infrastructure (e.g. on a construction site), through traditional Sub-1 GHz remote controls, as well as via the mediola connect app or a custom OEM app. Via Matter, the products can be integrated into the leading smart home platforms from Apple, Google, Amazon, Samsung, etc. and controlled and automated with their voice assistants and apps.

Based on an innovative and modular hardware architecture, the SH 2.0 module offers easy integration into a wide range of product designs. A key innovation is mediola's newly developed Multi-Stack technology, which enables simultaneous support for multiple communication protocols. The universal SH 2.0 Core Module operates autonomously and includes all control logic, including full Matter compatibility. To ensure easy adaptation to different mainboard configurations, mediola additionally provides special Adapter Boards as a flexible hardware bridge. These can be customized and equipped with 433 / 868 MHz transceivers, enabling reliable Sub-1 GHz communication. Thanks to the integrated Multi-Stack technology and mediola connect protocol, multiple applications and communication layers can run simultaneously. This allows products to be controlled via Thread, Bluetooth, and Sub-1 GHz wireless communication at the same time. Thus, devices can be operated via Bluetooth without network infrastructure (e.g. on a construction site), through traditional Sub-1 GHz remote controls, as well as via the mediola connect app or a custom OEM app. Via Matter, the products can be integrated into the leading smart home platforms from Apple, Google, Amazon, Samsung, etc. and controlled and automated with their voice assistants and apps.

The air conditioning unit weighs 69.73 pounds, which is relatively lightweight compared to other models on the market. One of the key features of the Midea MAP10S1XWT is its cooling capacity, which stands at 10,000 BTUs. This makes it suitable for use in small to medium-sized rooms, with a coverage area of up to 450 square feet. Additionally, the unit has a dehumidifying function that is capable of removing up to 73 pints of moisture per day. The Midea MAP10S1XWT is user-friendly, with an LED display and a remote control that allows users to adjust the temperature and settings from a distance. The unit also features a 24-hour programmable timer that can be set to turn on or off at specific times. One of the advantages of the Midea MAP10S1XWT is its washable and reusable air filter, which helps to remove impurities from the air. This makes it an ideal choice for those with respiratory issues. The unit operates quietly and efficiently, with a noise level as low as 51.5 decibels, making it suitable for use in quiet spaces such as bedrooms. Overall, the Midea MAP10S1XWT is a reliable and efficient air conditioning unit that is designed for use in small to medium-sized rooms. Its compact size, cooling capacity, and dehumidifying function make it a popular choice for those in need of a portable and efficient cooling system.

facts.value: ULTRA QUIET , The Midea U Smart Inverter AC unit is 9 times quieter than traditional units. The U-shape design uses your window to blocks noise outside and the high efficiency Inverter system warrants ultra low noise and vibration. This design allows for extremely quiet operation as low as 42 dBA , almost as quiet as a library , so you can get a restful night's sleep or binge your favorite shows undisturbed. MORE THAN 35% ENERGY SAVINGS , With the advanced DC Inverter technology, Midea U achieves over 35% energy savings compared to other traditional units, and it's the first window AC to obtain the ENERGY STAR Most Efficient 2022 Certification. You may also get exclusive benefits from your local energy distributor. FLEXIBLE WINDOW OPENING , Midea U-shaped design allows your window to open, bringing fresh air into your home anytime and allowing you to maintain more of your view even when the unit is installed. The Anti-Theft Mechanism locks the closed window for added security. SMART CONTROL , The Midea U Smart Inverter Air Conditioner is Wi-Fi enabled and can be controlled from anywhere through the cloud using the MideaAir app on iOS or Android. You can also use voice commands throughout your house, office, or apartment using Alexa or Google Assistant. Midea U is now certified with Matter. ROBUST INSTALLATION , Install the included quick-snap bracket, set the unit on the bracket, and secure the sidearms. After that, you are all done and ready to enjoy. Available for single-hung or double-hung windows with size: 22″-36″, minimal height at 13.75″.

facts.value: Philips EVNIA's AmbiScape ushers in the next evolution of ambient lighting for gaming monitors, building on the beloved Ambiglow experience found in current EVNIA displays. Ambiglow already enriches content by emitting adaptive LEDs that respond dynamically to on-screen color and brightness , creating a halo effect that makes movies, games, and media more immersive. AmbiScape takes this further by enabling connected, Wi-Fi-controlled lighting scenes through the Philips Precision Center app, giving users seamless access to extended lighting zones and modes that sync with audio, video, or user-defined patterns like wave and static effects. Designed with today's gamers and immersive experience seekers in mind, AmbiScape not only enhances atmospheric lighting around the monitor but also integrates with EVNIA's advanced AI functions to offer intelligent lighting behaviors tailored to different game types and user preferences. Whether you're deep in an RPG, coordinating visuals with dynamic audio, or simply want a mood-rich backdrop for evening gameplay, AmbiScape amplifies both the emotional and practical aspects of your setup. With easy Wi-Fi connectivity and a suite of customizable modes, this feature expands upon the immersive legacy of Ambiglow , making your gaming space feel more alive and responsive than ever.

facts.value: Matter Thread press/turn dimmer with smart home functionality. It can be connected both with and without a neutral wire (using a neutral wire is recommended for better stability). It features an optional startup level and works with LED, halogen, and dimmable electronic transformers. This smart dimmer allows you to customize lighting according to your usage patterns and desired atmosphere. Connect the dimmer to a Matter Thread bridge. With good indoor range, you can turn the lights on and off or dim them to the desired level from almost anywhere in the house. The dimmer has a staircase function, allowing you to turn on/dim the light with one dimmer and then turn it off with another switch, which is practical in large rooms, staircases, and corridors.

facts.value: Caveman makes affordable and easy to use Matter & Thread* enabled smart lighting that's no-nonsense and a great bang for the buck. No app download needed, works directly with your Google Home, Amazon Alexa or Apple Home app. Change colors (including warm to cool white light tuning), adjust brightness, and set schedules. Smart lighting doesn't have to be a confusing or frustrating experience, Caveman's got you covered. Whether working from home, studying, or looking to set a relaxing ambience for the end of your day, Caveman lights provide pure, rich colors and the most vivid and bright white lighting. *Thread border router required. Eligible thread border routers include: Google Nest Hub Max smart display Google Nest Hub (second gen) smart display Google Nest Wifi mesh router Apple TV 4K (second gen) Apple HomePod Mini Amazon Echo (fourth gen) smart speaker Nanoleaf Shapes, Elements, and Lines LED light panels All Wi-Fi 6 and up Eero mesh routers The list grows as more companies build thread border routers into their devices. Likely most new WiFi routers will have them in the future.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Get festive with Nanoleaf Smart Holiday String Lights! The perfect decoration for your tree, or throughout your home to bring out the holiday spirit! Customizable color palettes and lighting animations set the Christmas mood in an instant, with just the touch of a button or a simple voice command. Sync with your favorite holiday songs to watch as your lights dance to the beat. Designed for both indoor and outdoor use. 250 Addressable LEDs- Watch multiple colors appear across your string lights all at once for a stunning effect fit for the holiday season, or to brighten your everyday. 16+ Million Colours and Tunable Whites- Immerse yourself in a world of colors, or enjoy the ambient glow of a white Christmas at home. Animated Color Gradients & Scenes- Create your own custom color gradients, Scenes, and lighting animations through the Nanoleaf App. Set colors to flow and transition gradually, or pop up energetically to enhance the holiday cheer! Get Into The Music- Blast your favorite holiday playlists, and watch your lights dance to the beat of the music with Rhythm Scenes on the Nanoleaf app. Perfect For Indoors & Outdoors- Bring your interior and exterior spaces to life with vibrant light and color! Light up your tree,whether outside or inside,, use as an additional festive decoration, or even enjoy as year-round accent lighting. Easy Smart Control- Control through the Nanoleaf App via Wi-Fi, use manually with the attached Controller, or connect to a smart home ecosystem with Matter over Wi-Fi by adding a Matter compatible smart home hub to your setup. Requires a Matter compatible smart home hub and iOS/tvOS 16.5+ or Android OS 8.1+ to connect to a smart home ecosystem.

facts.value: The Fantaqi lumina is a versatile and customizable smart lighting solution that redefines how you interact with your environment. Featuring RGBIC addressable LEDs with multiple individually controllable zones, it provides a wide range of lighting effects and customization options. Powered by the Nanoleaf SmarterIQ technology, it connects to your mobile phone or Mac/PC via WiFi, allowing control through the Nanoleaf Desktop App. This integration enables advanced features like Rhythm and Screen Mirroring, enhancing your ambient experience. Designed for both functionality and style, the Fantaqi lumina is perfect for tech enthusiasts, gamers, and design-minded professionals seeking a smart, customizable lighting solution.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Get festive with Nanoleaf Smart Holiday String Lights! The perfect decoration for your tree, or throughout your home to bring out the holiday spirit! Customizable color palettes and lighting animations set the Christmas mood in an instant, with just the touch of a button or a simple voice command. Sync with your favorite holiday songs to watch as your lights dance to the beat. Designed for both indoor and outdoor use. Addressable LEDs- Watch multiple colors appear across your string lights all at once for a stunning effect fit for the holiday season, or to brighten your everyday. 16+ Million Colours and Tunable Whites- Immerse yourself in a world of colors, or enjoy the ambient glow of a white Christmas at home. Animated Color Gradients & Scenes- Create your own custom color gradients, Scenes, and lighting animations through the Nanoleaf App. Set colors to flow and transition gradually, or pop up energetically to enhance the holiday cheer! Get Into The Music- Blast your favorite holiday playlists, and watch your lights dance to the beat of the music with Rhythm Scenes on the Nanoleaf app. Perfect For Indoors & Outdoors- Bring your interior and exterior spaces to life with vibrant light and color! Light up your tree,whether outside or inside,, use as an additional festive decoration, or even enjoy as year-round accent lighting. Easy Smart Control- Control through the Nanoleaf App via Wi-Fi, use manually with the attached Controller, or connect to a smart home ecosystem with Matter over Wi-Fi by adding a Matter compatible smart home hub to your setup. Requires a Matter compatible smart home hub and iOS/tvOS 16.5+ or Android OS 8.1+ to connect to a smart home ecosystem.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Cono is a RGB smart lamp that can display more than 16 million colors, achieve 130 lumens, and has a lifespan of 25000 hours. Cono is enabled with Matter technology, Matter allows compatibility with major smart home ecosystems, providing more ways for users to customize and future-proof their smart homes. Cono is also equipped to work over Thread ,a fast, low-power wireless mesh network. All Thread-enabled devices connect to create a reliable self-reinforcing mesh network, rather than relying on a single connection source like with WiFi or Bluetooth. The Cono Lamp is simple to setup and easy to control with Nanoleaf's mobile app (Android & iOS) for mobile/tablet or The Nanoleaf Desktop App (Windows & Mac). Cono's playful design allows you to direct light where you need it by positioning it upright, on its side, or even upside down , for just a hint of illumination. It's unique leg design doubles as a handle so you comfortably move it around your home or use it like a torch. Constructed with a metal body on a stand molded from a durable recycled plastic mixed with wood fiber composite for an organic, modern appearance. Available in two colours Grey and Sierra. Measures 5.5 x 5.5 x 5.75 inches (14.2 x 14.2 x 14.6 cm).

facts.value: nRF Connect SDK A certified Matter 1.4.2 platform implementation built on Zephyr RTOS that provides hardware-abstracted Matter connectivity across Nordic Semiconductor's Matter-capable SoCs. The SDK supports Matter-capable SoCs in the nRF52, nRF53, and nRF54L Series and offers a wide range of RAM, NVM, GPIO, and peripherals for Matter products. The platform integrates the certified Matter 1.4.2 component through the nRF Connect SDK, supporting core Matter functionalities like Root Node device type (ID 0x0016). It supports concurrent Bluetooth LE commissioning and Thread networking, ensuring consistent Matter functionality and diagnostic capabilities across Nordic hardware. The nRF Connect SDK offers a robust, production-ready foundation for building Matter devices. It combines certified Matter functionality with Nordic's proven SoC portfolio and development tools.

facts.value: The Nordic Thingy:53 is an easy-to-use IoT prototyping platform suitable for Matter development. The Thingy:53 is built around the nRF5340 SoC which is the world's first wireless SoC with two Arm Cortex-M33 processors. The combination of two flexible processors, the advanced feature set, and an operating temperature up to 105 °C, makes it the ideal choice for Matter, LE Audio, professional lighting, advanced wearables, and other complex IoT applications. The Thingy:53 also includes many different integrated sensors, like environmental-, and color and light sensors, accelerometers, and a magnetometer, which all can be taken advantage of without additional hardware. It is powered by a rechargeable Li-Po battery with a 1350 mAh capacity that can be charged via USB-C. There is also an external 4-pin JST connector compatible with the Stemma/Qwiic/Grove standards for hardware accessories. The firmware of the Thingy:53 is built on top of the nRF Connect SDK which is the software development kit for the Nordic Semiconductor SoCs for Matter. It offers a complete solution that integrates the Zephyr RTOS, protocol stacks like Matter SDK, reference applications and hardware drivers. The certified Matter weather station application demonstrates the usage of the Matter application layer to build a weather station device using the Nordic Thingy:53. Such a device lets you remotely gather different kinds of data using the device sensors, such as temperature, air pressure, and relative humidity. The device works as a Matter accessory device, meaning it can be paired and controlled remotely over a Matter network built on top of a low-power, 802.15.4 Thread network.

facts.value: NXP's Matter with Wi-Fi edge development platform which streamlines design and enablement for Matter-enabled smart home and smart building devices, MW320/322 Wi-Fi microcontroller system-on-chip (SoC) is a single-chip SoC with 1×1 802.11n Wi-Fi and full-featured Cortex-M4F microcontroller that supports Matter natively. The SoC includes 512kB SRAM and a flash controller to enable executing code from external QSPI Flash. The SoC also enables easy interfacing to sensors, actuators, and other components via a full set of I/O interfaces including SPI, I2C, UART, I2S, PWM, ADC, DAC, and 50 GPIOs are available. The development platform kit includes a set of IO headers that bring out these interfaces to connect to external sensor or other peripheral boards. NXP has also enabled MW320/MW322 to be supported by the unified MCUXpresso development environment which further optimizes and enables rapid development of Matter-based capabilities on all NXP microcontrollers and wireless microcontrollers.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: The i.MX 8M Mini family is NXP's latest application processors that offers Embedded Linux and Android support. Matter support is enabled in the Yocto BSP for the device. The i.MX 8M Mini family offers ideal application processors configurations to implement Matter Controllers, Matter Commissioners, advanced Matter Devices, and Thread Border Routers. Matter is supported over Wi-Fi, with the NXP Wi-Fi drivers included in the Yocto BSP. The 88W8987 Wi-Fi module included in the i.MX 8M Mini EVK is used by default, however all of the Wi-Fi SoCs in mass-production from NXP can be used with the included drivers. Thread Border Router support is provided with OpenThread stack. The K32W061/41 radio coprocessors (RCP) are used to provide the Thread Border Router network interface. The EdgeLock SE05x (SE050/SE051) secure element family offers the most advanced security and cryptography performance for a Matter device.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: NXP's i.MX RT Crossover MCU + IW611/IW612 Tri-Radio Hosted Matter Development platform, which is seamlessly integrated with NXP's powerful IW611 wireless chip (with concurrent Wi-Fi® 6 + Bluetooth® 5.4) or NXP's powerful IW612 tri-radio chip (with concurrent Wi-Fi® 6 + Bluetooth® 5.4 + IEEE 802.15.4), which include the hardware, software and enablement needed to create advanced end devices using Matter over Wi-Fi and for IW612, Matter over Thread® to act as mesh extenders, Matter controllers or Thread Border Routers. This platform provides the capability to enable and extend full Matter functionality for both local and cloud-based control and monitoring of IoT products seamlessly across major ecosystems. NXP's crossover processors and MCUs marry the simplicity of MCUs with the complexity of applications processors into a hybrid device designed to address the growing consumer demand for enhanced user experiences in smart and secure high-performance products. Included in this class of products is the i.MX RT series of crossover MCUs that combines unprecedented performance with reliability and high levels of integration and security to propel industrial, IoT and automotive applications. IW611 /IW612 wireless SoCs include a full-feature Wi-Fi subsystem powered by NXP's 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) technology bringing higher throughput, better network efficiency, lower latency and improved range over previous generation Wi-Fi standards. The Wi-Fi subsystem integrates a Wi-Fi MAC, baseband, and direct-conversion radio with integrated PA, LNA, and transmit/receive switch removing the need for an RF front end module (FEMs) saving cost and reducing system complexity. In addition to a Wi-Fi 6 radio, the IW611/IW612 integrate an independent Bluetooth 5.3 subsystem that supports Bluetooth and Bluetooth Low Energy (LE). The device features Bluetooth Profiles such as hands free (HFP), advanced audio distribution profile (A2DP) for audio streaming as well as additional profiles like dual wide band speech (WBS). search_terms: The IW612 is a highly integrated 2.4/5 GHz dual-band 1×1 Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth/Bluetooth Low Energy and 802.15.4 tri-radio single-chip solution optimized for a broad array of IoT and industrial applications in smart home, smart devices and accessories, smart appliances, smart energy, industrial automation, gateways and many more. This high degree of integration contributes to very low system costs and a minimum external BOM while achieving efficient co-existence between all internal radios as well as external radios, such as LTE. IW612 includes a full-feature Wi-Fi subsystem powered by NXP's 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) technology bringing higher throughput, better network efficiency, lower latency and improved range over previous generation Wi-Fi standards. The Wi-Fi subsystem integrates a Wi-Fi MAC, baseband, and direct-conversion radio with integrated PA, LNA, and transmit/receive switch removing the need for an RF front end module (FEMs) saving cost and reducing system complexity. In addition to a Wi-Fi 6 radio, the IW612 integrates an independent Bluetooth/Bluetooth Low Energy and 802.15.4 subsystem that supports Thread mesh networks. The device features Bluetooth Profiles such as hands free (HFP), advanced audio distribution profile (A2DP) for audio streaming as well as additional profiles like dual wide band speech (WBS). For Bluetooth Low Energy, the IW612 enables 2 Mbit/s high speed data rate, long range, and extended advertising. Finally, LE Audio feature is supported utilizing isochronous channels for a better overall audio experience. The Tri-radio capability of the IW612 makes it an ideal device for Matter applications running over Wi-Fi and/or Thread. The IW612 can operate as a Matter Controller as well as Thread Border Router. This capability enables and extends full Matter functionality for both local and cloud-based control and monitoring of IoT products seamlessly across major ecosystems. The IW612 integrates dedicated CPUs and memories for both the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth/802.15.4 subsystems which enable real time, independent protocol processing. Interfaces for connecting the IW612 to external host processors include SDIO 3.0 for Wi- Fi, UART for Bluetooth and SPI for 802.15.4

facts.label: Certified name
facts.value: NXP IW610 Tri-Radio Wireless MPU Development Platform

facts.label: Description
facts.value: The IW610 Family features a 1×1 Dual-band (2.4 GHz / 5 GHz) Wi-Fi 6 radio subsystem, offering improved network efficiency, reduced latency and extended range compared to previous Wi-Fi standards. Its Bluetooth LE radio supports a high-speed data rate of 2 Mbit/s, along with long-range communication and extended advertising for network commissioning and sensor aggregation. The IW610 Family supports both dual and single-antenna configurations, ensuring efficient coexistence between internal and external radios. Incorporating NXP's EdgeLock security technology, the IW610 provides robust protection for secure boot, firmware updates and lifecycle management. Its advanced design delivers tight integration, low power consumption and secure operation, all in a compact, cost-efficient package. The IW610 is compatible with NXP's i.MX MPUs, i.MX RT and MCX host platforms. Its modular host driver architecture allows for easy integration with other MCUs and MPUs with minimal effort. It offers multiple interfaces for connecting to external processors, including SDIO and USB for Wi-Fi, UART or USB for Bluetooth and SPI for 802.15.4. Wireless modules based on the IW610 are available from leading module manufacturers, providing a convenient solution for rapid deployment.

facts.value: NXP IW612 Tri-Radio Wireless MCU Development Platform

facts.label: Description
facts.value: NXP's i.MX RT Crossover MCU + IW611/IW612 Tri-Radio Hosted Matter Development platform, which is seamlessly integrated with NXP's powerful IW611 wireless chip (with concurrent Wi-Fi 6 + Bluetooth 5.4) or NXP's powerful IW612 tri-radio chip (with concurrent Wi-Fi 6 + Bluetooth 5.4 + IEEE 802.15.4), which include the hardware, software and enablement needed to create advanced end devices using Matter over Wi-Fi and for IW612, Matter over Thread to act as mesh extenders, Matter controllers or Thread Border Routers. This platform provides the capability to enable and extend full Matter functionality for both local and cloud-based control and monitoring of IoT products seamlessly across major ecosystems. NXP's crossover processors and MCUs marry the simplicity of MCUs with the complexity of applications processors into a hybrid device designed to address the growing consumer demand for enhanced user experiences in smart and secure high-performance products. Included in this class of products is the i.MX RT series of crossover MCUs that combines unprecedented performance with reliability and high levels of integration and security to propel industrial, IoT and automotive applications. IW611 /IW612 wireless SoCs include a full-feature Wi-Fi subsystem powered by NXP's 802.11ax (Wi-Fi 6) technology bringing higher throughput, better network efficiency, lower latency and improved range over previous generation Wi-Fi standards. The Wi-Fi subsystem integrates a Wi-Fi MAC, baseband, and direct-conversion radio with integrated PA, LNA, and transmit/receive switch removing the need for an RF front end module (FEMs) saving cost and reducing system complexity. In addition to a Wi-Fi 6 radio, the IW611/IW612 integrate an independent Bluetooth 5.3 subsystem that supports Bluetooth and Bluetooth Low Energy (LE). The device features Bluetooth Profiles such as hands free (HFP), advanced audio distribution profile (A2DP) for audio streaming as well as additional profiles like dual wide band speech (WBS). For Bluetooth Low Energy, the IW611/IW612 enable 2 Mbit/s high-speed data rate, long range and extended advertising. Finally, LE Audio is supported utilizing Isochronous channels for a better overall audio experience. The IW611/IW612 integrates dedicated CPUs and memories for both the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth subsystems which enable real time, independent protocol processing. Interfaces for connecting the IW611/IW612 to external host processors include SDIO 3.0 for Wi-Fi, UART for Bluetooth, and SPI for IEEE 802.15.4 (IW612).

facts.label: Certified name
facts.value: NXP K32W148 Wireless MCU Development Platform

facts.label: Description
facts.value: NXP's broad portfolio of Matter development platforms which streamline designs for Matter-enabled smart home and building devices includes the K32W148 multiprotocol wireless microcontroller family. The K32W148 simplifies development for Matter end devices with its modular security and connectivity subsystems, allowing developers to focus on their innovation. The K32W148 Arm® Cortex®-M33 main core, with 1 MB on-board flash and 128 KB SRAM also includes a rich set of MCU digital and analog peripherals and multiple serial communication interfaces for embedded connected applications. Supporting the application core are a dedicated radio subsystem and an isolated EdgeLock® secure enclave. The radio subsystem, with its 256 kB Flash and 88 kB SRAM, offloads low-level radio operations from the application core, freeing resources for the main application, providing robust wireless performance and optimizing system level current draw.

EdgeLock® security technology is incorporated, offering secure boot, secure debug, secure firmware updates and secure life cycle management as well as hardware cryptography and physically unclonable function (PUF) for secure key management. The advanced design of the RW612 delivers tight integration, low power and highly secure operation in a space- and cost-efficient wireless MCU requiring only a single 3.3 V power supply.

It enables automatic energy-saving and control of equipment, contributing to a more comfortable and efficient living environment. Adding a storage and generation system further supports stable power supply during emergencies. The operation interface is compatible with dedicated monitors, smartphones, and connected door intercoms, providing flexible control options for users.

facts.value: A Smarter Way to Control Your Air: MirAIe delivers convenient control, connectivity and comfort. Seamlessly adjust temperature, monitor status and change modes right from the MirAIe App. Smart Cooling with AI Mode: AI mode powered by MirAIe senses external weather conditions like heat and humidity & automatically manages temperature, mode and fan speed to provide best cooling with optimum power consumption. Intuitive Voice Control: Introducing intuitive voice control with Google Assistant and Amazon Alexa control compatibility. Using your existing Google assistant or Alexa devices, control your Panasonic air conditioner with just your voice. ECONAVI: Enjoy Comfort With Energy Savings : ECONAVI has dual sensors , Human Activity Sensor and Absence Detection Sensor. Together, they monitor human location, movement and presence to use energy more efficiently. By adapting to the way you live and optimizing operation, this unique feature makes the air conditioning in your home more energy efficient. Aerowings: Fast Cooling with 4 Way Swing : The AEROWINGS is controlled by 2 independent motors and dual independent flaps. Airflow is delivered at a faster pace, spreading further at a concentrated level. Shower airflow spreads fast, cool and concentrated air across room and to the wall, then showers down gently. Auto Convertible Twin Cool Inverter: Energy Saving and Precise Temperature Control : All-in-One Auto-Convertible Panasonic Air Conditioners adjust the cooling capacity automatically basis the temperature and humidity level inside the room. Enjoy not just hassle-free cooling but save big on energy bills too. The Twin Cool Inverter provides a host of benefits for your comfort, such as quicker cooling upon start-up, constantly maintaining a set temperature, a wider power output range, reduced noise levels and energy savings. Jetstream: Cool Every Corner of your Room : Panasonic's Air conditioners comes with Jetstream airflow that can throw air up to 45 feet. The indoor unit has large air intake & Fan diameter which increases airflow. 7-in-1 Convertible AC: While Panasonic Inverter Air Conditioners are truly auto convertible, there is a provision to manually adjust the AC for up to 7 stages of cooling performance ranging from 40% to more than 100%, this can be done via Converti7 button on the remote or on the Miraie app Stabilizer Free Operation: Panasonic Air Conditioners are designed to operate under tough conditions with stabilizer free operation for voltage range between 100V-290V. If power fluctuation is beyond the stated limit, then a stabilizer is required. Long Term All Weather Endurance: The outdoor unit of Panasonic ACs is made of special material casing "Eco-Tough" made of Japanese steel that safeguards it from tough weather condition. Enjoy life long comfort with Panasonic AC that feature 100% pure copper coils for faster heat transfer and resistance to corrosion. Panasonic designs its products to be user friendly so our customers can use them for a long time with confidence.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Turn-key reference application for a Matter light switch included in the Qorvo IoT development Kit for QPG6105 and based on Qorvo's QPG6105 silicon. The Qorvo IoT Development Kit for QPG6105 provides a complete solution for building Matter, BLE and Zigbee applications for end devices with minimum application development effort. Besides a simple development environment, it contains example applications and several tools that make development of your IoT product, including Matter connected devices, easy. The development kit consists of a QPG6105 plug-on radio board and a carrier board. The carrier board enables application development and debugging of the radio board. It contains sensors and peripherals for easy demonstration of some of the QPG6105 capabilities. The development kit is the ideal starting point to get familiar with the QPG6105 SW and development tools. The QPG6105 is a low power communications controller implementing Zigbee, Thread, Matter, Bluetooth Low Energy and Bluetooth Mesh protocols. It features the hardware based ConcurrentConnect technology enabling multiple protocols to operate simultaneously, delivering improved capacity and enhanced interoperability with the leading low power standards. Reference designs, including ones for connected lighting are available to reduce time to market for customers.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: With REHAU Smart Privacy you can switch your window panes between transparent and opaque. In the transparent state you can see through the pane from the outside and inside as usual. When opaque, the pane is milky and therefore opaque. Within a few milliseconds you can set the desired discretion and at the same time let daylight into the room for a pleasant and cozy atmosphere. For the different system variants, a simple rocker switch or a double rocker switch is required for operation. Depending on your needs, various configurations of the switch an the Smart Privacy window to be controlled are possible: You can either operate a single window with one switch or control multiple windows simultaneously. Smart Privacy One can change the state of the entire window area, which means it can be switched fully opaque or fully transparent across the entire surface. Smart Privacy Select can be switched to opaque either across the entire window area or individual segments, from top to bottom , or vice versa. For example, only the upper third of the window can remain transparent, providing nice view, while the lower area offers the desired discretion. With Matter integration, Smart Privacy can now be seamlessly integrated into your smart home, allowing you to either automate the control or conveniently operate it remotely. This integration also enables further customization of the window pane switching states to suit your preferences.

facts.value: Smart window covering is an intelligent motorized product that seamlessly blends sophisticated design with cutting-edge technology. By integrating precision motor control with advanced Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity, smart window covering redefines convenience, comfort, and energy efficiency in your home or office. Effortless Remote Control Command your curtains from anywhere in the world. Using our intuitive smartphone app, you can open or close your curtains with a single tap, whether you're cozy on the sofa or miles away from home. Voice Command Integration Enjoy true hands-free operation. Smart window covering is compatible with popular smart home ecosystems like Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, and Apple HomeKit. Simply use your voice to adjust the privacy of any room. Customizable Automation & Schedules Program your curtains to operate on a daily schedule. Wake up naturally with curtains that open at sunrise, or have them automatically close at dusk for privacy and security. Create the perfect ambiance for every part of your day without lifting a finger. Smart Scene Management Integrate smart window covering into your broader smart home routines. Set a "Movie Night" scene to dim the lights and close the curtains automatically, or a "Good Morning" scene to open them and let the sunshine in. Enhanced Energy Efficiency Take control of your home's temperature intelligently. By automatically closing curtains during the hottest part of a summer day, smart window covering helps block solar heat gain, reducing the load on your air conditioning and lowering energy costs. Quiet & Powerful Motor Experience powerful and silent operation. The ultra-quiet, high-torque motor ensures smooth and reliable movement, built to handle various curtain weights and sizes with ease. Smart window covering is more than just a convenience; it's a sophisticated upgrade to your living space. It offers unparalleled control, enhances your comfort, and contributes to a more sustainable and secure home.

records.name: Schlage Sense Pro
notes: Smart Deadbolt
search_terms: The Schlage Sense Pro Smart Deadbolt delivers precise hands-free unlocking, giving you premium security with cutting-edge convenience. With Apple hands-free unlock with home key and Schlage Converge technology, simply walk up to your Schlage Sense Pro Smart Deadbolt and it will automatically unlock using your iPhone or Apple Watch. Sense Pro's Schlage Converge technology uses Ultra Wideband to deliver exceptional accuracy. Schlage Converge pinpoints your iPhone or Apple Watch and calculates your approaching speed, trajectory and motion, unlocking as you reach your door. Unlike geofencing or proximity-only technologies, Schlage Converge gives Sense Pro the unique ability to unlock only when you're at your door and ready to enter, offering a smarter hands-free unlocking experience that combines ultimate convenience with trusted security. Sense Pro offers seamless smart home interoperability with Matter over Thread, making it easy to pair your devices and integrate with your smart home ecosystem. With multiple access options, including hands-free unlocking, tap to unlock with Apple home key, key code entry, one-touch locking and remote management through the Schlage Home app, it's more convenient than ever to come and go with ease.

facts.value: The SenseSay Matter WiFi Smart Thermostat is an advanced smart temperature controller designed for electric underfloor heating, heating mats, infrared heating systems, convectors, and water-based floor heating with actuators. Supporting the Matter standard, it integrates seamlessly with leading smart home ecosystems including Apple Home, Google Home, Amazon Alexa, and Samsung SmartThings, allowing centralized control from your preferred platform without the need for a dedicated manufacturer app. Equipped with both a built-in air temperature sensor and support for external NTC floor or air sensors, the thermostat delivers precise temperature regulation and enhanced comfort. Its powerful 10A switching capacity makes it suitable for a wide range of residential and commercial heating applications. The thermostat offers customizable temperature settings, adjustable hysteresis, temperature calibration, child lock, automatic button lock, sleep mode, and advanced protection features including overheating protection and sensor diagnostics. In the event of a power outage, all settings and schedules are securely stored in non-volatile memory, while the internal backup power source maintains the clock for up to three days. Designed for modern interiors, the compact thermostat is compatible with popular 55×55 mm frame systems from leading manufacturers such as Gira, Jung, Schneider Electric, Merten, Berker, Livolo, DKC, and others. With reliable Wi-Fi connectivity, Matter-certified interoperability, and robust safety features, the SenseSay Matter WiFi Smart Thermostat provides intelligent, energy-efficient climate control for today's connected homes.

Its minimalistic and modern design makes it suitable for any home environment while offering professional grade safety performance. With long battery life, safety certification, and support for firmware updates through Matter 1.4, MSC-1 delivers dependable protection and future ready connectivity. Sensereo brings together innovation, design, and safety to create a truly essential smart home device.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Shelly 2PM Gen4 is a small form factor 2-channel smart switch with power measurement and cover control, which allows remote control of electric appliances through a mobile phone, tablet, PC, or home automation system. It can work standalone in a local Wi-Fi network or it can also be operated through cloud home automation services. The device also has improved processor and increased memory compared to its predecessor. The device supports Venetian blinds similar to it's predecessor Shelly 2PM Gen3. Shelly 2PM Gen4 can be accessed, controlled and monitored remotely from any place where the user has internet connectivity, as long as the device is connected to a Wi-Fi router and the Internet. It can be retrofitted into standard electrical wall boxes, behind power sockets and light switches or other places with limited space. Shelly 2PM Gen4 has embedded Web Interface which can be used to monitor and control the device, as well as adjust its settings. The device has multi-protocol wireless MCU which provide Zigbee and Bluetooth connectivity ensuring a secure connection.

facts.value: Shelly 1L Gen3 is a compact smart switch tailored for lighting control. A standout feature of this device is that it doesn't require a Neutral wire to operate. However, it needs a Shelly Bypass 1L/2L Gen3 connected in parallel to the load. You can conveniently manage your lighting through a mobile phone, tablet, PC, or home automation system. The device can function standalone within a local Wi-Fi network or can be integrated with cloud home automation services. As long as the Shelly 1L Gen3 is connected to a Wi-Fi router and the Internet, users can access, control, and monitor it from anywhere. Designed with adaptability in mind, Shelly 1L Gen3 is engineered to snugly fit within standard electrical wall boxes, be discreetly placed behind light switches, or in other areas where space might be a limiting factor. An added benefit is its embedded Web Interface, which allows users to not only monitor and control their lighting but also to fine-tune the Device settings with ease.

facts.value: Shelly 2L Gen3 is a compact, two-channel smart switch tailored for precise lighting control. A standout feature of this device is that it doesn't require a Neutral wire to operate. However, it needs a Shelly Bypass 1L/2L Gen3 connected in parallel to the load at the first channel. Shelly 2L Gen3 allows users to effortlessly control their lighting setups through a mobile phone, tablet, PC, or integrated home automation system. The device can function standalone within a local Wi-Fi network or can be integrated with cloud home automation services. As long as the device remains connected to a Wi-Fi router and the Internet, users gain the flexibility to access, control, and monitor their lighting configurations from virtually anywhere. Designed with adaptability in mind, Shelly 2L Gen3 is engineered to snugly fit within standard electrical wall boxes, be discreetly placed behind light switches, or in other areas where space might be a limiting factor. An added benefit is its embedded Web Interface, which allows users to not only monitor and control their lighting but also to fine-tune the Device settings with ease.
