facts.label: Description
facts.value: Shelly Pro RGBWW PM is a DIN-rail mountable, five-channel smart light controller. It has 5 inputs (button, switch or analog), and five outputs. The device is commonly used with LED strips. It supports 4 profiles , RGB and CCT (default), CCT x 2, RGB and lights x 2 and Lights x 5. In Lights x 5 profile, 5 different led strips (groups of lights) can be controlled independently. Power measurement functionality allows real time track of the voltage, current and power consumption. The device can work standalone in a local Wi-Fi network or it can also be operated through cloud home automation services. It can be accessed, controlled, and monitored remotely from any place where the User has internet connectivity, as long as it is connected to a Wi-Fi router and the Internet. Shelly Pro RGBWW PM has an embedded Web Interface which can be used to monitor and control the Device, as well as adjust its settings.

facts.value: ZBBridge-PR2 is a smart home bridge based on the Zigbee 3.0 protocol. Perfect for: Parties Gaming rooms Home theaters Dance sessions Relaxing background ambience DIY Lighting Customization Personalize your lighting exactly the way you want. With advanced smart controls you can: Customize colors and brightness Create your own lighting scenes Save favorite presets Group multiple lights together Set schedules and timers Wake up to gentle lighting in the morning or automatically dim the lights at night. facts.value: The BrizLabs Smart Floor Lamp combines a minimal vertical form with a dual-zone light engine (pole + luminous base) for layered ambience and accurate whites. •Optics: RGBCW 5-channel; CCT 2100,5700K; linked or independent zone control. •LEDs: Strip 126×RGB + 126×White (2-in-1); Base 24×RGB + 24×White (2-in-1). •Output & Power: 1725 lm single-color / 2500 lm mixed; 38W ±10%; 24V/2A with 100,240V input. •Control: BrizLabs App (brightness/CCT/color/scenes/zones/timers/groups) + inline controller. •Size: Total 1503 mm; pole 1320 mm (3 sections), 24×24 mm; base 187 mm H, 118×118 mm top, 130.5×130.5 mm bottom; soft-touch coated emitting surface. •Ingress Protection: Lamp IP44, power IP44, controller IP65. •Use Cases: Living rooms, media/gaming corners, bedrooms; place 15,30 cm from wall for smooth gradient wash. •In the Box: 3-section pole, luminous base, inline controller, 24V/2A adapter, quick start guide.

facts.value: This smart door/window sensor is designed to reliably detect open and close events in real time, providing accurate status monitoring for residential and commercial environments. Using low-power wireless connectivity, the sensor continuously monitors door and window activity and transmits events securely to a central system or cloud platform. Its compact, unobtrusive design allows for easy installation on doors, windows, or other entry points without impacting aesthetics. The sensor supports real-time alerts, historical event logging, and seamless integration with security, automation, and property management systems. Built for stability and energy efficiency, it is suitable for long-term deployment in apartments, hotels, offices, and short-term rental properties where reliable access monitoring is critical.

facts.value: Bridge Max (Bridge-M) is a versatile smart bridge that serves as an access and relay hub for multiple smart home protocols. It supports connecting and managing Zigbee devices, Bluetooth devices (including eWeLink-Remote and BTHome), devices under an eWeLink account, and devices in Home Assistant. With its Matter Bridge capability, Bridge-M can expose these devices to third-party Matter platforms for unified cross-platform control. Bridge-M also supports integrating itself and its added Zigbee devices into Home Assistant via MQTT, enabling centralized management of Bridge-M within Home Assistant.

facts.value: ZBBridge-PR2 is a smart home bridge based on the Zigbee 3.0 protocol. It also supports local scene, ensuring that automations continue to run reliably even when the network is unavailable, providing users with a more reliable and convenient smart home experience.

facts.value: Smart Plug Operation Guide: Energy Saving & Remote Control 1. Setup Plug into a 100-240V outlet; LED flashes blue (ready). Download the app (iOS/Android) via QR code, create an account, and add the device. Connect to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi as prompted. Solid blue LED = ready. 2. Remote Control Mobile app: Select the plug in the app to toggle power remotely (e.g., turn off a forgotten heater). Check real-time status instantly. Alexa voice control: In app settings, link to Alexa. Use commands like "Alexa, turn off living room plug" or "Check coffee maker." 3. Energy-Saving Tools Schedules: Set daily/weekly auto-off (e.g., 10 PM for routers). In app: "Timer" > "Add Schedule" > set time/days. Countdown: For temporary use (e.g., fans). Set duration; plug shuts off automatically. Energy tracking: App shows hourly/daily/weekly usage. "Energy Reports" highlight high-consumption devices. Set alerts for excess use (e.g., over 5kWh/day). 4. Pro Tips Group plugs (e.g., "Bedroom") to turn all off with one tap. "Away mode": Random on/off for lamps saves more than constant use. Manual button works offline if Wi-Fi fails. Safety eep dry; clean prongs monthly. Control anywhere, cut waste,smart, simple, cost-effective

facts.value: The EFR32MG24 Wireless SoCs are ideal for mesh IoT wireless connectivity using Matter, OpenThread and Zigbee protocols for smart home, lighting, and building automation products. With key features like high performance 2.4 GHz RF, low current consumption, an AI/ML hardware accelerator and Secure Vault, IoT device makers can create the smart, robust, and energy-efficient products that are secure from remote and local cyber-attacks. An ARM Cortex-M33 running up to 78 MHz and up to 1.5 MB of Flash and 256 kB of RAM provides resources for demanding applications while leaving room for future growth. Target applications include gateways and hubs, sensors, switches, door locks, LED lighting, luminaires, location services, predictive maintenance, glass break detection, wake-word detection, and more.

facts.value: SiWx917 Wi-Fi 6 plus Bluetooth Low Energy (LE) 5.4 SoCs

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Our SiWx917 SoC is our lowest power Wi-Fi 6 SoC, ideal for ultra-low power IoT wireless devices using Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Matter, and IP networking for secure cloud connectivity. It is optimal for developing battery operated devices that need long battery life. SiWx917 SoC includes an ultra-low power Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth Low Energy (LE) 5.4 wireless CPU subsystem, and an integrated micro-controller (MCU) application subsystem, security, peripherals and power management subsystem all in a single 7×7 mm QFN package. The wireless subsystem consists of a Network Wireless Processor running up to 160 MHz, baseband digital signal processing, analog front end, 2.4 GHz RF transceiver and integrated power amplifier. The application subsystem consists of an ARM Cortex-M4F running up to 180 MHz, embedded SRAM, FLASH, and Sensor Hub. The ARM Cortex-M4F is dedicated for peripheral and application-related processing, while the network wireless processor runs the wireless and networking stacks on independent threads, thus providing a fully integrated solution that is ready for a wide range of embedded wireless IoT applications.

facts.value: Silicon Labs Matter GSDK Extension v2.3.0-1.3

This new device enhances convenience and security by allowing users to manage these systems remotely and reliably, integrating with Matter-compatible smart home platforms. In addition, users have the flexibility to monitor the status of the entry system through the use of a wireless sensor or a wired sensor, providing adaptable solutions to suit different installation needs and preferences. This ensures that users maintain full awareness and control over their entrance systems, improving security and accessibility.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: The STM32WB5MM-DK Discovery kit is designed as a complete demonstration and development platform for the STMicroelectronics STM32W5MMG module based on the Arm Cortex-M4 and Arm Cortex-M0+ cores. The STM32 device is a multi-protocol wireless and ultra-lowpower device embedding a powerful and ultra-low-power radio compliant with the Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) SIG specification v5.2 and with IEEE 802.15.4-2011. The hardware features of the Discovery kits are available for users to develop their applications: Audio, USB, user buttons, and Bluetooth Low Energy. Extension connectors allow easy connection of an ARDUINO board for a specific application. An ST-LINK/V2-1 is integrated on the board, as an embedded in-circuit debugger and programmer for the STM32 MCU and the USB Virtual COM port bridge

facts.label: Description
facts.value: This LED ceiling light consumes a maximum of 42W and produces a luminous flux of 5300Lm. The brightness can be dimmed in 10 steps, and the color temperature can be adjusted in 20 steps between 3000 and 6500K. Furthermore, this ceiling light has an air purification function. The air is sucked in through three large HEPA filters on the main body, and as the air passes through the HEPA filters, it catches dirt in the air in the room. The air that passes through the HEPA filter is further sterilized inside the unit by the UV-A light inside the unit. Cleaned air inside the ceiling light is exhausted diagonally downward from three points on the main body of the ceiling light, and circulates efficiently in the room. The volume of the airflow can be selected from six levels with the remote control. Smartphone or voice can be used to turn the wind on or off and the lighting can be turned on or off, as well as dimming and color control.Product size is 530 x 530 x 100 mm.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: Tethral is the mobile-first Matter controller built natively on Android. The app on the user's phone is the controller, communicating with Matter-certified devices directly, without a hub, bridge, or manufacturer cloud service in between. A responsive environment is one that acts in concert with the person living in it. Tethral makes that possible through composition: users describe what they want in their own words, and the app assembles the connections that make it happen. Tethral works across Matter-certified devices, and is built to extend across common smart-home ecosystems, software services, and AI tools as the product grows. and A simulation environment lets users try compositions before deploying them physically. Templates and suggestions help users get started. The app is designed for everyone, no scripting, no configuration, no technical expertise required.

search_terms: Tethral is the mobile-first Matter controller built natively on Android. The app on the user's phone is the controller, communicating with Matter-certified devices directly, without a hub, bridge, or manufacturer cloud service in between. A responsive environment is one that acts in concert with the person living in it. Tethral makes that possible through composition: users describe what they want in their own words, and the app assembles the connections that make it happen. Tethral works across Matter-certified devices, and is built to extend across common smart-home ecosystems, software services, and AI tools as the product grows. and A simulation environment lets users try compositions before deploying them physically. Templates and suggestions help users get started. The app is designed for everyone, no scripting, no configuration, no technical expertise required.

facts.value: The SimpleLink CC2674 device is a multiprotocol and multi-band 2.4 GHz, and CC1354 is Sub-1GHz and 2.4GHz wireless microcontroller (MCU) supporting Matter, Thread, Zigbee, Bluetooth 5.3 Low Energy, IEEE 802.15.4, IPv6-enabled smart objects (6LoWPAN), Wi-SUN, Amazon Sidewalk, proprietary systems, including the TI 15.4-Stack, and concurrent multiprotocol through a Dynamic Multiprotocol Manager (DMM) driver. They enable long range and reliable communication in building security systems, HVAC, smart meters, medical, wired networking, portable electronics, home theater & entertainment, and connected peripherals markets. The highlighted features of this device include: Arm TrustZone based secure key storage, device ID and trusted functions support. Multi-band device supporting concurrent multiprotocol for both Sub-1 GHz and 2.4 GHz through a DMM driver. • Wide flexibility of protocol stack support in the SimpleLink LOWPOWER F2 Software Development Kit (SDK). • Longer battery life wireless applications with low standby current of 0.83 µA and full RAM retention. • Industrial temperature ready with lowest standby current of 5 µA at 85 C. • Advanced sensing with a programmable, autonomous ultra-low power Sensor Controller CPU with fast wake-up capability. As an example, the sensor controller is capable of 1 Hz ADC sampling at 1 µA system current. • Low SER (Soft Error Rate) FIT (Failure-in-time) for long operation lifetime with no disruption for industrial markets with always-on SRAM parity against corruption due to potential radiation events. • Dedicated software controlled radio controller (Arm Cortex-M0) providing flexible low-power RF transceiver capability to support multiple physical layers and RF standards. • Excellent radio sensitivity (-121 dBm) and robustness (selectivity and blocking) performance for SimpleLink long-range mode.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: QuickSet is Universal Electronics' software product family and the de facto solution for simplifying universal discovery, control, and interaction of devices within the home. First introduced in September 2009, QuickSet solution is a widely deployed technology powering major consumer electronic brands including set-top boxes, televisions, gaming consoles, smartphones, and tablets to enable effortless configuration and control of nearly any connected home entertainment device as well as an expanding range of popular home automation devices. This software solution supports multiple communication mediums ranging from HDMI to IP, and different wireless protocols such as Zigbee, Bluetooth, and Infrared. With the addition of Matter, QuickSet ensures interoperability with newer devices by acting as a Matter Controller while maintaining compatibility with existing devices in the home.

It can be connected to all devices such as home automation, smart energy and home security systems to provide users with an intelligent control experience.

Featuring a compact water station that installs in minutes and connects to existing plumbing, S10 enables true hands-free cleaning. It offers 6500Pa of powerful suction, automatic dust collection, and a unique self-cleaning roller mop that washes while it mops. When encountering carpets, it lifts the mop, stops water flow, and scrapes excess moisture to avoid wetting the carpet. The mop is automatically dried after each clean. With built-in AI obstacle avoidance, LDS navigation, and app-based zone control, S10 intelligently maps and cleans your space. It can even refill compatible humidifiers, making it the first robot of its kind to interact with IoT appliances. Compatible with Matter 1.4, S10 integrates smoothly into smart home ecosystems for seamless automation and control.

facts.value: 100% Automated Cleaning: SwitchBot S10 robot vacuum and mop combo uses a Dual Station Design to make cleaning truly hands-free. It features a never before seen Water Station that directly connects to household plumbing systems, eliminating the need for manual water refilling or draining. Once it completes a cleaning schedule, it returns to the self-empty station for hot air drying and dust collection for up to 70 days. Simply set it and forget it! Unique Water Station: To make S10 robotic vacuum 100% automated, we created a Auto-Refill and Drain Water Station designed to be compact and can be used without the need for cables, making it easy to place in places with plumbing systems such as kitchens or laundry rooms. We provide a variety of retrofit accessories to easily adapt to existing water pipes or faucets, and installation only takes a few minutes. Self-Mop-Washing On the Go: The robot vacuum cleaner cleans your home and self-washes its mop at the same time thanks to our RevoRoll Roller Mop design and RinseSync. Our roller mop uses 10N worth of pressure to efficiently remove stubborn dirt and can avoid damaging flooring too. RinseSync enables its Roller Mop to self-washing in real time, making sure it doesn't spread dirt around the home. 6500Pa Powerful Suction Power: Suitable for removing hair and is an ideal choice for pet families. Multiple cleaning modes can adapt to full coverage of your home. When encountering carpets, S10 robot mop can also automatically lift its roller mop up and enhance suction power, ensuring that no blind spots are missed. Multiple Ways to Control: S10 robot vacuum supports Alexa and Google Home, using voice commands to make cleaning easier. You can customize cleaning and schedules using our app. An even set up restricted areas and virtual walls, with rich features at your fingertips. This device is also part of SwitchBot Ecosystem and you can link products together for even more home automation.

facts.value: Detailed Introduction to AI Hub AI Hub is an intelligent central gateway integrating large-scale pre-trained language models (VLM) and edge computing, focusing on local intelligence and scenario-based linkage. Its core functions are as follows: I. Core Intelligent Capabilities Full Frigate Compatibility: Supports all Frigate functions and works with all RTSP cameras; built-in 6T computing power enables local Frigate model deployment, no external computing needed. Functional AI Division: AI is divided by scenario for precision. Cameras focus on single functions for efficient event interpretation, including Security Manager (monitors human presence, climbing, etc.), Care Manager (monitors phone use, eating, etc.), Pet Manager (monitors pet activities), and Custom (beta, detects subtle screen changes). VLM Automated Linkage: After event reporting, matches camera function, scenario and face info to trigger preset actions (e.g., pushes alerts for strangers, turns on floor lamps when phone use is detected). Local AI Detection: Recognizes humans, pets, vehicles, etc., enabling linked automations; face recognition distinguishes acquaintances/strangers (e.g., alerts parents when kids return home). II. Multi-Protocol Gateway Compatibility: Built-in Home Assistant Core Container for native access to its Bluetooth/Wi-Fi devices; BLE support without USB dongle; connects 30 SwitchBot sub-devices to Matter ecosystem. Local Hub Capability: Stores automation rules locally; schedules devices via LAN/Bluetooth for offline automation and local App control. III. Convenient Functions & Expansion Efficient Info Processing: Auto-generates structured daily reports on functional events; AI search finds similar records via keywords. HDMI Visual Extension: Requires separate Type-C to HDMI adapter for displaying camera events and AI analysis (add to SwitchBot App first); SwitchBot App and VLM service support all RTSP cameras.

search_terms: Relay Switch 1 is a smart relay switch designed for home automation. Here are its main features: 1. Smart Control: Relay Switch 1 can turn traditional appliances and lighting into smart devices, allowing users to control them remotely via smartphone or voice assistants. 2. Wi-Fi Connectivity: No additional hub or gateway is required, as Relay Switch 1 connects directly to the local network via Wi-Fi, simplifying installation and use. 3. Multi-Function Operation: The device supports switching, timers, and scene settings, enabling users to automate their devices according to personal preferences, enhancing home convenience. 4. Voice Control: Compatible with voice assistants such as Amazon Alexa and Google Assistant, allowing users to control appliances with simple voice commands. 5. Safety Design: Equipped with overheat protection to ensure safe operation. Relay Switch 1 is ideal for lighting control, appliance management, door control, and other home electrical devices, offering a flexible and powerful smart home solution.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: A new era of cleaning The K10+ Pro Combo has set off a revolutionary change in the field of home cleaning with its innovative 3-in-1 design. Its breakthrough design is not only far ahead in cleaning effect, but also realizes the perfect combination of intelligence, convenience and humanity, redefining the home cleaning experience. All-round cleaning The robot has super vacuuming capabilities and intelligent route planning, which can efficiently complete floor cleaning tasks, while the handheld vacuum cleaner focuses on cleaning every detail such as furniture, sofas, curtains, etc. Through the mutual cooperation of the two, the whole house can be cleaned. Intelligent and innovative design The base station of this product has unique DuoBase™ technology, combined with the Auto-Empty automatic dust collection system, which allows the sweeping robot and handheld vacuum cleaner to collect dust and charge on the same base station. Almost no user participation is required during operation, reducing the number of manual operations. Matter Support for Seamless Smart Home Integration The K10+ Pro Combo robot vacuum cleaner supports Matter through a hub that supports SwitchBot Matter. Within the Matter system, the robot vacuum cleaner's functionality will be further expanded to enable interconnection between different devices within the local area network.

facts.value: The K11+ Pro is the ultimate compact cleaning powerhouse. Building on the proven K11+ platform, this upgrade delivers a massive leap in performance,without adding a single inch to your space. At its heart, a 12000Pa hurricane suction motor delivers double the cleaning force of its predecessor. Fine dust, pet hair, embedded debris,all captured in one decisive pass. A high-precision edge sensor enables millimeter-level wall-following accuracy, ensuring corners and baseboards are left spotless. Battery life jumps 10%, giving the K11+ Pro the endurance to tackle larger homes and multi-room layouts on a single charge,no interruptions, no compromises. The auto-empty station remains the smallest in its class,45% more compact than the K10+ generation,yet still houses a full 4L dustbag for up to 90 days of hands-free disposal. Smallest body. Strongest clean. The K11+ Pro proves that real power needs no extra space.

facts.value: The SBS0A Matter Base Station connects to the cloud via Wi-Fi through a router and communicates with various child devices via a private RF network (868/915 MHz), presenting the status of these child devices to third-party ecosystems as Matter devices. Matter Role: This product functions as a MatterBridge (gateway/bridge), using Matter over Wi-Fi for communication. The base station itself is added to the ecosystem as a Matter node, and each RF sub-device is exposed to the ecosystem as a BridgedDevice. Supported Ecosystems (Multi-Administrator/Multi-Fabric): Amazon Alexa, Google Home, Apple Home, Samsung SmartThings, Home Assistant.

facts.value: ULTRALOQ Smart Matter Door Lock, leveraging the cutting-edge Matter over Thread protocol, designed to provide you with unparalleled control and convenience. Our innovative door lock offers a variety of unlocking options that cater to your unique lifestyle. Whether you prefer using your fingerprint for quick access, entering a code for added security, utilizing the convenience of our Smart Ecosystem APP, voice controlling via the ecosystem, or using a traditional mechanical key, our Smart Door Lock has you covered. The lock's Matter over Thread technology seamlessly integrates with popular smart home platforms. Whether you're using Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, or Smartthings, you can easily manage access to your home. This interoperability ensures your lock fits perfectly into your smart home setup, providing enhanced security with the ease of automation. With its built-in Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) technology, our Smart Door Lock also supports the U-tec WiFi Bridge. This allows you to control access with the U-home app both locally or remotely, adding an extra layer of convenience to your home security. Power efficiency is also a key feature of our Smart Door Lock. Powered by 8 AA batteries, it offers an extended battery life, ensuring your home remains secure and access is always available when you need it. Upgrade your home security with our Smart Door Lock , a perfect blend of convenience, control, and cutting-edge technology. It's not just a door lock, it's a gateway to a smarter lifestyle.

facts.value: FlowWash Real-Time Self-Cleaning Track Mop: The Narwal Flow robot vacuum and mop combo features the revolutionary FlowWash Mopping System with dual water tanks and a built-in scraper. It washes the high-speed rotating track mop in real time, using 113°F hot water and 1.22 kg downward pressure to help remove stubborn stains in one pass,keeping the mop fresh and preventing dirty water from spreading for consistently superior cleaning. TwinAI Dodge Obstacle Avoidance: Dual HD cameras paired with intelligent AI enable this robotic vacuum to recognize and avoid over 200 object types with high precision,navigating around furniture, sliding through tight spaces, and cleaning close to cords without getting tangled or stuck. Zero-Tangling Cleaning with 22,000Pa Ultra-Strong Suction: This self-emptying robot vacuum delivers deep cleaning power for fine dust and heavy debris alike. The DualFlow Tangle-Free System cleans every angle without hair wrap: a single-side roller brush channels hair directly into the dustbin, while side brushes automatically switch from V-shape to II-shape for effortless maintenance. Unmatched CarpetFocus Technology: The Narwal Flow automatically lowers its brush cover to create a sealed high-pressure airflow zone on rugs, boosting pickup performance by up to 2× compared to standard robotic vacuums. It captures embedded debris and pet hair deep within carpets, reducing the need for a separate cordless vacuum. No Edge Left Behind: A reversing side brush sweeps deep into corners, while the EdgeReach Mop extends to within 5mm of walls,capturing up to most of hidden dust and debris along baseboards and edges for complete room coverage. Reaches High & Low with Ease: The Narwal Flow robot mop climbs over 1.6″ ledges,including thresholds, U-shaped furniture, and room dividers,without assistance. At just 3.7″ tall, it glides under beds, sofas, and cabinets to clean where you can't reach, with a slim, stylish design that fits easily into your home. Control your robot vacuum cleaner hands-free via Alexa, Google Assistant, Siri, or the built-in "Hey Nawa" voice command. Schedule cleanups, adjust settings in the Narwal app for smoother smart-home integration. AI-Adapted Base Station with Full-Cycle Cleaning: The intelligent base station washes the mops with 173°F hot water and dries them with 104°F warm air, keeping the pads fresh and ready for the next use. A 2.5L dust bag stores up to 4 months of debris, while a built-in stirrer prevents messes,delivering a spotless home with minimal effort. Reminder 1: Before first use of the Nawal Flow, update to the latest software version for the best overall performance. Reminder 2: Narwal Flow supports BOTH 2.4GHz and 5GHz WiFi networks.

facts.label: Description
facts.value: The Matter bridge is a bridging solution designed to seamlessly connect existing non-Matter smart devices with the Matter-supporting ecosystems. Through the bridge, non-Matter devices can be uniformly registered, discovered and managed, enabling intercommunication operations with Matter-compatible devices. The bridge supports functions such as commissioning, device deleting, status synchronization, and controlling. It also handles dynamic endpoint mapping and cluster mapping to ensure that the status and control data of devices with different protocols can be synchronized to the Matter network in real time. It not only extends users' existing smart home investments, but also provides developers with flexible device access solutions, simplifies multi-protocol management, and supports OTA upgrades, enabling the entire smart home system to achieve high interoperability on the basis of security and reliability.
